WITH resolved AS (
         SELECT pt.id_cliente,
            pt.puntos,
            COALESCE(pt.id_cycle, ( SELECT legacy.id_cycle
                   FROM points_cycles legacy
                  WHERE legacy.id_cliente = pt.id_cliente AND pt.created_at >= legacy.primer_acumulado_at AND pt.created_at < legacy.vence_at
                  ORDER BY legacy.primer_acumulado_at DESC, legacy.id_cycle DESC
                 LIMIT 1)) AS effective_cycle
           FROM points_transactions pt
        ), ledger_balance AS (
         SELECT resolved.id_cliente,
            COALESCE(sum(resolved.puntos), 0::bigint) AS ledger_points
           FROM resolved
          GROUP BY resolved.id_cliente
        ), pending_expired_cycles AS (
         SELECT pc.id_cliente,
            pc.id_cycle,
            COALESCE(sum(r.puntos), 0::bigint) AS remaining_points
           FROM points_cycles pc
             JOIN resolved r ON r.effective_cycle = pc.id_cycle AND r.id_cliente = pc.id_cliente
          WHERE pc.estado_ciclo_codigo = 'activo'::text AND pc.vence_at <= now()
          GROUP BY pc.id_cliente, pc.id_cycle
        ), pending_expiration_by_client AS (
         SELECT pending_expired_cycles.id_cliente,
            sum(GREATEST(pending_expired_cycles.remaining_points, 0::bigint)) AS pending_expired_points
           FROM pending_expired_cycles
          GROUP BY pending_expired_cycles.id_cliente
        )
 SELECT lb.id_cliente,
    (lb.ledger_points::numeric - COALESCE(pe.pending_expired_points, 0::numeric))::integer AS balance_puntos
   FROM ledger_balance lb
     LEFT JOIN pending_expiration_by_client pe ON pe.id_cliente = lb.id_cliente;
